LESSON: NUTRITION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BIOLOGY
Strand: Anatomy and Physiology of Animals
Topic 3.1: Nutrition
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Nutrition, part of Anatomy and Physiology of Animals in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 BIOLOGY.

Key inquiry question: How do insects and birds feed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Nutrition together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner cooperates with others while collecting fresh specimens of insects to

observe their mouthparts.

• Digital literacy: The learner uses digital devices to access and watch animations/videos on mouth parts of different

insects and beaks of birds.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner diligently observes safety precautions as they collect fresh specimens of insects to

observe their mouthparts.

49

• Social justice: The learner promotes equity, equality and gender consideration in distribution of learning resources

as well as assigning responsibilities during group activities.
